prompts:
Create a BACK-VIEW companion sprite atlas for the attached FRONT-VIEW atlas. This is production game animation artwork, not a poster. Preserve EXACTLY the same 12 characters, armor colors, headgear, weapons, horses, capes, height relationships, outlined pixel style and texture density as the front atlas. The second attachment is the original approved style reference. Do not add or remove characters. Do not replace with geometric simple shapes. Crisp clustered hand-drawn pixel art, dark outlines, NO antialiasing, no blur.

Output landscape 3:2 with EXACT SIX equal columns and FOUR equal rows on REAL TRANSPARENT background. Same row-major character ordering and two frames per character as the front atlas: columns 1-2 first character, 3-4 next, 5-6 third, next row repeats. No visible grid, labels, text, scenery, glow, shadows or ground. Keep complete weapons and plumes inside each cell, 8% padding. Every sprite faces AWAY from viewer towards upper-right (northeast): see back of helmet/head, cape/armor back and horse rump/flank; NO front-facing human faces. Same 3/4 overhead view. First frame ready idle; second subtle alternate-step walking, same facing and identity. The front and back sprites are the SAME units viewed from opposite sides, not new designs. Small riders sit naturally on four-legged compact horses; infantry keep their approved cute proportions.

Character pairs, row-major:
1. guan: green robed red-faced bearded general on FOOT, green cap, crescent glaive
2. lubu: EXACT mounted Lu Bu from the approved image, black/gold armor, TWO long red curved plumes, red cape, chestnut horse, silver halberd
3. zhao: silver/teal armored young lancer on a white horse
